summary: Drive Claude Code through long tasks it would otherwise drop
content: Stagent | Drive Claude Code through long tasks it would otherwise drop | Product Hunt Launching today Stagent Launching today Drive Claude Code through long tasks it would otherwise drop 24 followers Drive Claude Code through long tasks it would otherwise drop 24 followers Visit website AI Coding Agents • AI Engineer Claude Code is great at starting long tasks — bad at finishing. It self-approves, patches symptoms, fakes TDD, stops at "code written." Stagent drives Claude Code through any state machine you define (e.g. plan → verify → review → ship). Different agents per stage - it can't self-approve or bail halfway. Describe your own workflow in plain English with /stagent:create, or fork one from the cookbook: stagent.worldstatelabs.com/cookbook Plus: live viewer, cross-machine resume. title: Tenure
summary: Your AI finally learns how to talk to you
content: Tenure | Your AI finally learns how to talk to you | Product Hunt Launching today Tenure Launching today Your AI finally learns how to talk to you 21 followers Your AI finally learns how to talk to you 21 followers Visit website AI Infrastructure Tools • LLM Developer Tools You explain something to one person and it goes over their head. Same thing, different person, clicks instantly. The difference isn't the information. It's knowing how someone hears things. That's what Tenure learns.
